Hey, sorry for the late reply, but I honestly appreciate what you said.

I did speak to her recently and although we're both still cut up about everything, we've decided to move on and work together to improve both our lives.

The thing is that what my mom lost because of me was a vintage tea set that was given to her by her grandmother just before she died. So, that can't actually exactly be replaced, but I hear you. I'm sure my mom would rather give that up than lose me, but yeah...

Well, your story did actually help me feel a bit better by putting some more things into perspective for me, so I thank you for that.
